Messages.Author: Ego_Sum
Messages.Body:
Name: The 4 apocalypse Riders

Author: Iñaki Puigdollers

Description: this is an straight forward shambling hordes deck, so
what it does is play Hordes and smash 'em on your prey's (sometimes
predator) head. Some people blame me of being to risky and straight
forward when building/playing a deck, what I mean is ... if I build an
ally deck I'll try to make the deck play 'em as fast and take profit
of them the sooner the better, that's the reason why sometimes my
decks seem a little bit weak against some types of predators but their
defense is their full attack 8in this kind of decks).

Crypt 12 (Max. 20, Min. 12, Avg. 3,916)

3 Isabel Giovanni
2 Le din Tho
2 Gloria Giovanni
3 Rudolfo Giovanni
1 Lia Milliner
1 Marcianna Giovanni

Library 74

Master 13

4 Accquired Ventrue Assets
1 Charisma
3 Path of Bone
1 Powerbase montreal
3 Dreams of the Sphinx
1 Secure haven (mostly contest but also Tho protection)

/*No blood dolls for the reason above written, plus in this deck
normalli a blood doll means that shambling Hordes are 2 blood and 1
pool worth, that's why I prefer to add some more blood-healing cards
instead. Also I 'd like to add some Life in the city but there's no
room for 'em.*/

Allies 19

18 Shambling Hordes
1 Leonardo the Mortician

Equipement 1

1 Sargon's Fragment

Reaction 10

4 Deflection
2 Redirection
2 Delaying Tactics
2 Wake with evening freshness

Action Modifier 4

4 Call of the hungry Dead
4 Conditioning

Combo 4

4 Spectral Divination

Action 11

2 Sanguine Instruction
2 Far Mastery
3 Summon Soul /*helps in hordes recycling and vamps refresh*/
4 Compel the Spirit /*A little multi rush*/

Combat 8

6 Fake out
2 Trap

/*Maybe swap trap for 2 fake out more which means more anti-gun
efficiency and more vampire defense, but trap with Compel the spirit
is so delicious...*/

Greetings,

Iñaki, Prince of Barcelona

P.S. I'd also like with this post your opinion about deck building. Do
you normally prepare defense against everything in any deck you build
or, opposite, you sometimes sacrifice self defense (or at least this
is waht it seems) for a full attack or a better developement of your
deck? Thanks in advance.

grand' prey will also get some, and you get a chance to go for the table...

Messages.Author: Ego_Sum

"Orpheus" <orph...@free.fr> wrote in message news:<3f57ace7$0$16554$626a...@news.free.fr>...

Reason for playing Marcianna:

-dom means:

- Able to deflect

- Can occasionally modify if bleeding

- Ocasionally Far mastery inferior level

-Is a Giovanni towards AVA (can also recruit leonardo)

-Can delay some painful vote

-Can block Rush (o stealth rush, the usual ones: Bum's rush, ambush,
Theo...).

-Can rescue vampires from Torpor

-Can diablerize

-With sanguine instruction can even redirect and recruit hordes at
inferior level

-With Sargon fragment and one of the paths/Charisma can recruit hordes
at superior level.

-Her ability is really cool against voters (specially) and crostable
help

-She is an small-cap so she helps against early weenie hordes

Reason for not playing her:

-Cannot recruit hordes since 1st turn she is out

-Cannot redirect too good

-Her ability cannot be used with allies

-She is too small so she gets wasted early

For there are more reasons to play her than to avoid that. And IMO
there are heavier reasons to play her. But well I know this is only an
opinion.



> the card game you would expect to go with life. Then again VtES blood

Sorry. Guess I'm still mixing metaphors, thinking that allies have life
"instead of" blood.

> Either way it seems weird that you can't get any blood out of a dead

You can, but the Taste of Vitae isn't about drinking the blood out of
the vessel. It's about the blood that has been spilled. The vessel need
not even be dead. Perhaps vampire's blood is potent enough to allow the
meager rations one could get from splatters to suffice, whereas the same
is not true of the unenhanced blood of a mortal.
